name: publicWeb_resolveKennelsByUuid
description: Resolves one or more comma-separated PublicKennelId UUIDs to kennel slugs, names and optional custom domains, for the legacy URL shim that redirects old hashruns.org hash-based URLs (/#/RD?publicKennelIds=...) to the path-based site. Malformed UUIDs are skipped via TRY_CAST; deleted/removed kennels are omitted. Unauthenticated.

parameters.name: PublicKennelIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated PublicKennelId UUIDs, as the legacy URLs carry them. Invalid entries are ignored. No SQL default.
parameters.typeMismatch: Kennel.PublicKennelId is UNIQUEIDENTIFIER; the parameter is a delimited NVARCHAR(MAX) list split with STRING_SPLIT and TRY_CAST per item.

rowsets.name: ResolvedKennels
rowsets.description: One row per list item that resolves to a live kennel (a UUID repeated in the list returns its kennel twice). Zero rows when none match. Order is not guaranteed.

columns.name: KennelSlug
columns.description: HC.Kennel.KennelUniqueShortName — used to build the new path-based URL

columns.name: KennelName
columns.description: Full kennel name — used for display in the multi-kennel picker when more than one UUID resolves

columns.name: CustomDomain
columns.description: Custom domain (e.g. 'lh3.com') if the kennel is on tier 3; NULL otherwise. The redirect should use the custom domain when present.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Instead of ResolvedKennels on a runtime error (CATCH).

codeSmells.detail: @PublicKennelIds (line 2) has no SQL default. A caller that omits it fails with 'expects parameter' before the SP runs: the API shim's catch logs only a generic exception row and returns 500, and the SP's own graceful checks and error envelope never run.
Line 38 splits on ',' where the project rule is '|'. Deliberate: the list is copied verbatim from legacy inbound URLs that used commas, and UUIDs cannot contain either character.

codeSmells.issue: CATCH block does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: Lines 44-47 return { Success = 0, ErrorMessage } without an HC.ErrorLog row; the shim's generic log of the envelope is the only record.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove KennelSlug, KennelName, or CustomDomain columns — all three are consumed by the Next.js shim
Never change malformed-UUID behaviour to throw — silent skip is intentional for robustness with old inbound links
